nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $V$ an $A$-module and $M$ a submodule of $V$. For a maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$ of $A$, let $M_{\mathfrak m}$ be the saturation of $M$ at $A \setminus \mathfrak m$, that is, the set of $v \in V$ with $s v \in M$ for some $s \in A \setminus \mathfrak m$. Then $M$ is the intersection of the submodules $M_{\mathfrak m}$ over all maximal ideals $\mathfrak m$ of $A$.

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $V$ an $A$-module, $M$ a submodule of $V$ and $S$ a submonoid of $A$. The saturation of $M$ at $S$ is the submodule of $V$ consisting of the elements $v \in V$ such that $s v \in M$ for some $s \in S$.
nodes.title: Saturation of a submodule at a submonoid

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $V$ an $A$-module, $M$ a submodule of $V$ and $S$ a submonoid of $A$. An element $v \in V$ lies in the saturation of $M$ at $S$ if and only if $s v \in M$ for some $s \in S$.
nodes.title: Membership in the saturation

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $V$ an $A$-module, $M$ a submodule of $V$ and $v \in V$. Suppose that for every maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$ of $A$, $v$ lies in the saturation of $M$ at $A \setminus \mathfrak m$, that is, $s v \in M$ for some $s \in A \setminus \mathfrak m$. Then $v \in M$.
nodes.title: Membership is detected at the maximal ideals

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $V$ an $A$-module, $M$ a submodule of $V$ and $v \in V$. Suppose that for every prime ideal $\mathfrak p$ of $A$, $v$ lies in the saturation of $M$ at $A \setminus \mathfrak p$, that is, $s v \in M$ for some $s \in A \setminus \mathfrak p$. Then $v \in M$.
nodes.title: Membership is detected at the prime ideals

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
